source_issues.detail: src_1 (Pike 2003) is declared abstract-only and 'not used in the proof'; the proof indeed never invokes it. Not checked by me (no browsing); no reliance, so no issue.
src_2 (Q_5 draft) is internal prior work; Lemmas 1–7 are restated with proofs in the candidate text, so the argument is self-contained and does not depend on the citation.

computation_issues.detail: code_3 (C brute force, Computation 2) was not re-run by the orchestrator. It is redundant: code_2 (trusted re-run, 0.6 s, 0 forests) refutes the same finite statement (★₀) for h=0,1,2 with a pruning rule justified in the text (two even vertices at distance 2 share exactly two odd neighbours; if neither is removed they close a 4-cycle), which I checked and is valid. Optional request: compile with cc -O2 and run (claimed 10.3 s) to obtain the promised independent confirmation.

code_6 (independent string-based DFS count of the labelling) failed under the orchestrator only because no stdin was supplied (assert on 64 strings). Not evidence of invalidity. Request: re-run with the 64-string list from code_5's stdout piped in; expected output 204 / 12 valleys. Upper bound is already established by the trusted re-run of code_5 (204, 12 valleys) and by the hand count 36·1+28·6.

code_5, code_7, code_8 import conta_cammini.py (from the Q_5 certificate), which is not among the submitted artifacts. The orchestrator's clean-copy re-run of code_5 and code_7 succeeded, so the module is present in the sandbox; for hand-in it must be shipped with the code.
code_8 (simulated annealing, exploration only, not part of the proof) needs a seed argument; orchestrator ran it without one. Irrelevant to the bound.

code_4 part A: DFS pruning |N(B)|≤20 is valid because N(B) is monotone in B and 7+b≤20 for b≤13; enumeration is exhaustive over B∋100000 (WLOG by even translation, transitive on the odd class, after the class-swap WLOG |A|≥b). Part B: R=N(o)∪(≤2 extra even), |H|≤#extra, H drawn from R∪(O∖{o}) — matches the derived constraints |R|=33−q∈{6,7,8}, |H|≤|R|−6. Trusted re-run: 18878 nodes / 0 sets; 254840 pairs / 0 forests.

references: code_5 (trusted re-run: 204 paths, 12 valleys, labelling printed)
claim_provenance.notes: Lower bound = hand reduction to finite statements (★) refuted by exact integer/bitmask enumeration; all essential computations (code_2, code_4) re-run by the orchestrator with matching output, total <5 s, well under the 10-minute limit; code included and its role explained, as the official rules require. Upper bound = explicit labelling in the required format with trusted exact count. No literature used as proof. Consistency with verified_2/verified_3 is stated but not needed.

report.reproducibility_notes: Essential lower-bound computations code_2 and code_4 and upper-bound count code_5 reproduced by the orchestrator (python3, clean copies) with outputs identical to the candidate's claims; exact integer arithmetic throughout, no floating point in the proof path; total runtime ≈4.2 s. Not reproduced: code_3 (C, redundant with code_2), code_6 (needs stdin — pipe code_5's 64-string output), code_8 (needs seed argv; exploration only). For hand-in, bundle conta_cammini.py and cubo6.py with the scripts and give the exact commands (including `cc -O2 verifica_q6_foreste.c` and `python3 verifica_dfs_204.py < ordine.txt`).
